title: Best Trakkr Alternatives (2026): Who Fits Which Need
metaDescription: Six Trakkr alternatives with prices checked in October 2026: AEOeye, Otterly, Peec, Nightwatch, AthenaHQ and Profound, and when Trakkr is still the right call.
shortAnswer: The best Trakkr alternative depends on why you are leaving. For a one-off answer, use AEOeye: a free ChatGPT check, then a $29 five-engine report. For cheaper daily tracking, look at Otterly from $29 a month or Peec from $95. For rank tracking plus AI prompts, Nightwatch starts at €79 a month on yearly billing. AthenaHQ and Profound suit action-heavy or enterprise teams.
intro:
This guide is based on public documentation as of October 2026: each vendor's own pricing page, plus Trakkr's billing guide and FAQ. We have not tested any of these products hands-on, and AEOeye is our own product, so it is listed with its limits.

Prices move often and several of these pages render them with JavaScript, so check the vendor page before you buy.

sections.heading: Why look for a Trakkr alternative?
sections.body:
Three things in Trakkr's own documentation send people elsewhere: there is no free plan, the 50-prompt cap is per brand on every plan, and a dashboard still needs someone to act on it. None is a flaw; each is a fit question.

1. **No free plan, and a card for the trial.** Trakkr's [FAQ](https://trakkr.ai/learn/docs/faq) states there is no free version, only a 14-day Growth trial that needs a card. Growth then costs $100 a month for one brand.
2. **A prompt ceiling per brand.** Growth and Scale both include 50 active prompts per brand. Scale adds brands, not depth: its [pricing page](https://trakkr.ai/pricing) says the per-brand depth is the same on both. More prompts are paid add-ons.
3. **Measurement before action.** Trakkr's Agent can change nothing until you grant permission per work area, so a person still does the fixing. If you only need to know where you stand, a subscription is more than the question needs.

sections.heading: Which Trakkr alternatives fit which need?
sections.body:
Match the alternative to the reason you are leaving. Each need below has one clear pick.

- **A one-off answer instead of a subscription:** AEOeye.
- **Cheapest entry to daily tracking:** Otterly.
- **Lean analytics with a model choice:** Peec AI.
- **Rank tracking and AI prompts in one tool:** Nightwatch.
- **Credit-metered actions:** AthenaHQ.
- **Enterprise security and scale:** Profound.

The table shows each vendor's own figures, checked on 2026-10-03. "Answers per month" is how that vendor counts included AI responses, so treat the cost-per-answer row as our arithmetic, not like-for-like pricing.

sections.heading: How does each alternative work, and who is it for?
sections.body:
Each alternative trades something against Trakkr: price, engines, depth or commitment. Here is the honest fit for each, from its own pages.

![Close-up of a signpost in New South Wales pointing to global cities](https://images.pexels.com/photos/33263430/pexels-photo-33263430.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1200)

- **AEOeye** is a one-off audit, not tracking. The free audit asks ChatGPT three unbranded buyer questions; the [$29 report](/pricing) adds Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity and ten questions. Best for a first answer. It will not show trends.
- **[Otterly](https://otterly.ai/pricing)** starts at $29 a month for 15 prompts on four engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot). Claude is a $29 add-on on Lite. Best for the lowest recurring price.
- **[Peec AI](https://peec.ai/pricing)** starts at $95 a month for 50 prompts and three models you choose from six. Best for small teams that want focused analytics.
- **[Nightwatch](https://nightwatch.io/pricing)** bundles keyword rank tracking with 50 AI prompts from €79 a month on yearly billing, 14-day trial with no card. Best if you track Google rankings too.
- **[AthenaHQ](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing)** has a free plan with $25 of credit, then Starter at $295 a month for 3,600 credits. Best if you want credit-metered actions.
- **[Profound](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing)** offers a free 7-day trial (50 prompts, three engines) and quote-only Enterprise. Best for large teams needing SSO and SOC 2.

sections.heading: What does Trakkr cost, for reference?
sections.body:
Trakkr Growth is $100 a month, or $1,000 on annual billing, for one brand with 50 prompts across eight models. Scale is $500 a month for ten brands. Enterprise starts at $1,000 a month billed annually. Prices are billed in USD, per Trakkr's [pricing page](https://trakkr.ai/pricing).

Here is the surprise: Trakkr is not expensive per answer, only per entry. Included answers per month and our arithmetic:

- **Trakkr Growth:** 12,000 data points, about $0.008 each.
- **Peec Starter:** 4,500 answers, about $0.021 each.
- **Nightwatch Starter:** 1,500 answers, about €0.053 each.
- **AthenaHQ Starter:** 3,600 credits (one per AI response), about $0.082 each.

So if you will really use 50 prompts across many models, Trakkr's headline price buys more volume than most. If you will use fewer, a cheaper plan wins. For the add-on maths, see our [Trakkr pricing breakdown](/blog/trakkr-pricing).

sections.heading: When is Trakkr still the right choice?
sections.body:
Trakkr is still the right choice when you need all eight models on every plan, daily history and a team workflow, and you will use the volume. Do not leave it only because the entry price looks high.

![Multi-directional signpost in a Japanese park surrounded by trees](https://images.pexels.com/photos/23897494/pexels-photo-23897494.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1200)

- **You track many models.** Grok, DeepSeek and Meta AI are included with no per-model fee, per its FAQ.
- **You run client brands.** Scale lists ten brands, unlimited seats, a REST API and white-label portals.
- **You want a money-back path.** New subscribers get a 14-day guarantee in its [terms](https://trakkr.ai/terms).
- **You will review it weekly.** Trakkr's workflow runs from pages to actions to measured results.

We cannot judge the quality of its data, because we have not used it. Use the trial to check that. Our [head-to-head with AEOeye](/vs/trakkr) goes deeper.

sections.heading: What should you check before paying for any tracker?
sections.body:
Check how the vendor counts usage, which engines each plan includes, and whether you can test without a card. Those three details change the real price more than the headline number does.

- **The unit.** Trakkr sells data points, Peec sells monthly AI answers, AthenaHQ sells credits, Nightwatch sells prompts and answers. Convert each to answers per month before you compare.
- **The engines.** Peec Starter lets you choose three models; Otterly Lite charges extra for Claude. A cheap plan that omits the engine your buyers use is not cheap.
- **The method.** Trakkr says it queries providers' own APIs. Ask each vendor how it collects answers, then compare tools with the same prompts side by side during trials.

Our wider shortlist is in [the best AI visibility tools](/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools).

sections.heading: How do you choose in ten minutes?
sections.body:
Decide the job first, then the price. Four steps settle most cases.

1. **Name the job.** One answer ("are we recommended?") needs an audit. A trend over months needs a tracker.
2. **Count your questions.** Trakkr's FAQ suggests starting with 5 to 20 buyer questions. Under 20 prompts, Otterly Lite or Peec Starter may be enough.
3. **List the engines your buyers use.** Peec Starter limits you to three models; Nightwatch and Trakkr include six or more.
4. **Test before paying.** Use Nightwatch's no-card trial or Profound's free trial. Trakkr's trial asks for a card.

In [AEOeye's audit records](/resources/aeoeye-recommendation-benchmark-2026-09.json) (127 audits, June to September 2026), answers named 2.9 competitors on average, a small, self-selected sample. Seeing who is named instead of you is the real first step. [Start with the free audit](/).

keyTakeaways: People leave Trakkr mainly over no free plan, the per-brand 50-prompt ceiling and the need for a person to act on the data, not over quality.
For a one-off answer, AEOeye (free ChatGPT audit, $29 five-engine report) fits; it shows no trends.
For cheaper daily tracking, Otterly starts at $29 a month and Peec at $95; Nightwatch is €79 a month on yearly billing and adds rank tracking.
Trakkr is cheap per answer (about 0.8 cents on our arithmetic) and expensive only per entry, so heavy users should not leave on price alone.
Test first: Nightwatch's trial needs no card, Profound's is free, Trakkr's needs a card.

faqs.q: What is the best free alternative to Trakkr?
faqs.a: AEOeye offers a free audit, but it is ChatGPT-only and three questions; Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity are in the $29 one-time report. AthenaHQ has a free plan with $25 of credit (300 credits). Profound has a free 7-day trial. Trakkr itself has no free plan, only a card-required 14-day trial.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest daily-tracking alternative to Trakkr?
faqs.a: Otterly Lite is $29 a month for 15 prompts on four engines, as of October 2026. Peec Starter is $95 a month for 50 prompts and three models. Cheapest entry is not cheapest per answer: Trakkr Growth lists 12,000 data points for $100, so heavy users may pay less per answer there.

faqs.q: Is AEOeye a like-for-like replacement for Trakkr?
faqs.a: No. AEOeye runs a one-off audit, not daily tracking, so it cannot show how your visibility changes over time. It suits readers who want to know once whether engines recommend them. If you need continuous monitoring, choose a tracker such as Trakkr, Otterly, Peec or Nightwatch.

faqs.q: Which Trakkr alternative also tracks Google rankings?
faqs.a: Nightwatch. Its Starter plan is €79 a month on yearly billing and combines 500 tracked keywords with 50 AI prompts across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Mode and AI Overview, with a 14-day trial that needs no card. Trakkr focuses on AI visibility rather than classic rank tracking.

faqs.q: When should I stay with Trakkr?
faqs.a: Stay if you use many of its eight models, manage several brands, or review the dashboard weekly. Its headline price covers 12,000 data points a month, which is more volume than most entry plans. Leave if you only need a one-off answer or fewer than about 20 prompts.
